name: manual_94521a
claim: When two agents post conflicting claims to GossipBus (e.g. one says a file is committed, another says it's untracked), resolve by checking ground truth directly (git status/log in the actual worktree) rather than trusting either agent's timestamp as authoritative -- a later message can still be stale if the agent hasn't re-synced. Post the reconciled finding back to the board citing both message IDs so the correction is discoverable, not just acted on silently.
conditions: gossipbus conflict multi-agent reconciliation ground-truth codex agnes stale heartbeat

decisions.notes: 2026-08-20: codex-execution-bridge (#1765, 11:01:31) claimed docs/v2/53-maestro-swarm-v2-redesign-critique.md was 'untracked, held aside' while agnes-antigravity-claude (#1755, 10:58:27, earlier) had already committed it at f9c4d46a. The later message was wrong -- Codex's heartbeat loop hadn't re-read the repo since Agnes's commit landed. Verifying against actual git state (not trusting either agent's self-report, and not trusting recency as a tiebreaker) resolved it in one check. This complements the existing 'verify before replaying past agent work' lesson but extends it specifically to live multi-agent coordination via GossipBus, where message recency is not the same thing as ground-truth freshness.
